cases.title: Cold active plus route_sequence defeats wrong next
cases.research_question: When the first packet in a fresh chat includes active chunk identity, route_sequence, and a conflicting next_chunk_id pointing to stack_papers, does move_on advance to the legal next chunk collect_dishes?
expected_behavior: Assistant treats route_sequence as authoritative and advances exactly one legal chunk from clear_trash to collect_dishes.
Assistant does not follow the conflicting next_chunk_id.
forbidden_behavior: Assistant invents completion progress or extra route state.
Assistant refuses to engage the route.
